release_notes:
Database Migrator — import an existing Dhru Fusion or GSM Tool database

Adds Miscellaneous → Database Migrator: a self-serve admin tool to import your
existing site's data (users with passwords & credits, catalog, orders,
invoices, tickets) from a Dhru Fusion or older GSM Tool database dump.

- Pick the source (GSM Tool or Dhru Fusion) and upload a .sql dump
- Merge or Replace modes, with a dry-run to preview counts before writing
- Live progress log; IDs are remapped and credits re-encrypted on import
